aria.lede: Villa Aria is a newly renovated luxury resort-style waterfront home in North Miami with over 10,000 square feet of contemporary living, wide-bay views, and a resort-style pool deck.
aria.description: Villa Aria is a newly renovated luxury resort-style waterfront villa, offering over 10,000 square feet of modern contemporary living space. Villa Aria is the definition of Miami grandeur, featuring six bedrooms and six and a half bathrooms plus an office, den, gym, and sauna. Villa Aria’s eye-catching yet functional design offers ample open spaces and wall-to-wall sliding glass doors that completely open, creating the ultimate indoor–outdoor experience. High-end finishes in natural tones and splendid scenery of Miami Beach. Embrace the living areas and oasis-like pool deck with breathtaking wide-bay views. Inside, a state-of-the-art kitchen sits between the living, formal dining, and family room — all opening to the pool deck featuring a spa and patio with a summer kitchen and a Naples-style outdoor pizza oven. The exquisite master suite includes custom-built closets and a luxe bath — brilliantly designed for seamless connection between the indoor and outdoor.

Interior finishes, master chef’s kitchen, a built-in bar, an outdoor kitchen and barbecue area, and a private sauna make this home the perfect all-inclusive vacation rental villa retreat.

Beautiful gardens provide tons of privacy; a lush tropical oasis sits beside the large heated saltwater pool, featuring palm trees, plumerias, birds of paradise, and orchids. The circular driveway has automatic gate entry. Additional features include a jacuzzi and a large tiki hut. Blockchain Manor features state-of-the-art kitchen appliances both inside and out: Viking custom fridge (to match kitchen cabinets) and an outdoor kitchen decked out with mini fridge and gas grill, perfect for entertaining. Six bedrooms include both an expansive master and junior master upstairs; downstairs are four bedrooms as well as a movie theater that doubles as an additional sleeping space with adjacent full bathroom. A game room containing pool table and foosball also has a flatscreen TV to catch all the games. Sonos speakers throughout the property offer an unmatched entertaining experience.

The West Wing includes a queen guest room with water views, a twin room that doubles as service quarters, and a chef’s kitchen with full walk-in. The East Wing living room features blue and gold accents, a 70″ TV, and professional sound. Upstairs, three more bedrooms include the Blue and Sunrise rooms (three queens each) and the Lime room — all with bay views and a wraparound balcony.
